d: Dzeron, n. (Zoöl.) “The Chinese yellow antelope (Procapra gutturosa), a remarkably swift-footed animal, inhabiting the deserts of Central Asia, Thibet, and China.”
Dzeron, n. (Zoöl.) “The Chinese yellow antelope (Procapra gutturosa), a remarkably swift-footed animal, inhabiting the deserts of Central Asia, Thibet, and China.”
1. The fifth letter of the English alphabet.
2. (Mus.) “E is the third tone of the model diatonic scale. E (E flat) is a tone which is intermediate between D and E.”
